**Hydrogen (H)** – the simplest and most abundant element in the universe

| Category | Property | Value / Description |
|----------|----------|---------------------|
| **Basic data** | Symbol | H |
| | Atomic number | 1 |
| | Atomic mass (average) | 1.008 u (protium 1.007825 u, deuterium 2.014102 u, tritium 3.016049 u) |
| | Electron configuration | 1s¹ |
| | Periodic group | 1 (alkali metals, but unique as a non‑metal) |
| | Period | 1 |
| | Block | s‑block |
| | Standard state at 25 °C, 1 atm | Gas |
| | Molar mass | 1.008 g mol⁻¹ |
| | Density (liquid, 20 °C) | 0.0708 g cm⁻³ |
| | Density (gas, 0 °C, 1 atm) | 0.08988 g L⁻¹ |
| | Boiling point | –252.87 °C (20.28 K) |
| | Melting point | –259.16 °C (14.01 K) |
| | Critical temperature | 33.41 °C (306.56 K) |
| | Critical pressure | 12.8 MPa |

| | Enthalpy of formation (ΔHf°) | 0 kJ mol⁻¹ (by definition for elemental H₂) |

| | Heat capacity (Cp, gas, 298 K) | 28.836 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ |
| | Ionization energy (first) | 13.598 eV |
| | Electron affinity | –0.754 eV (negative → energy released when adding an electron) |
| | Electronegativity (Pauling) | 2.20 |

| | Magnetic moment | 2.792847 µB (for proton) |
| | Spin | ½ (proton) |

| **Chemical behavior** | Bond type | Diatomic covalent (H₂) |
| | Oxidation states | +1 (most common), –1 (hydride H⁻) |
| | Acid strength | Very weak acid (pKa ≈ 35 in water) |
| | Basicity | Very weak base (pKb ≈ 35 in water) |
| | Hydride ion (H⁻) | Strong reducing agent; forms metal hydrides (e.g., NaH, CaH₂) |
| | Hydrogen bonding | Forms strong H–bond donors/acceptors (e.g., in water, alcohols) |

| | Deuterium (²H, D) | Stable, heavier isotope, used in heavy water (D₂O) |

### Quick facts

* **Atomic weight**: 1.008 u (average)
* **Standard molar volume**: 22.414 L mol⁻¹ (at 0 °C, 1 atm)
* **Molecular weight of H₂**: 2.016 g mol⁻¹
* **Bond dissociation energy of H₂**: 436 kJ mol⁻¹
* **Dipole moment of H₂**: 0 D (non‑polar)
* **Spectroscopic constants**: Rotational constant B₀ ≈ 44.594 cm⁻¹

These values are taken from the latest CODATA recommendations and IUPAC standards.
